children: said on Tuesday there has been no impact to its offshore production in the US-regulated Gulf of Mexico.

Chevron also said its onshore facilities, including a crude oil refinery in Pascagoula, Mississippi, which is the closest to the storm's expected landfall as a hurricane later this week, are following plans to prepare for high winds and heavy rain.
